purpose: Classify every top-level Markdown document under docs/ so no loose or ambiguous handoff/plan file can silently become project authority.
rule: Every docs/*.md file must appear exactly once here. Only category=authority files may define cross-project operating precedence. Current work starts at docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json.note: Development-only real-human source identities, permitted conclusions and uncertainty for anatomical deformation review; never production media or geometry-copy authority.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_BODY_MASTER_PLAN.json.note: Machine-readable governing plan for whole-body human movement/anatomy progression; open Critical/High whole-body issues override historical phase readiness.

categories.authority: Read first or use for cross-project precedence.
categories.current_technical: Current technical specification or task handoff.
categories.verification: Current audit, gate, or acceptance procedure.
categories.future_technical: Prepared future work; do not execute unless CURRENT_HANDOFF names it.
categories.supporting_reference: Supporting provenance/recovery/design record; not an operational entry point.
